sources.title: Detection of An Unidentified Emission Line in the Stacked X-ray spectrum of Galaxy Clusters

evidence.text: A line-free multitemperature APEC continuum plus individual Gaussians models the 2–10 keV search band, followed by 3–6 keV fitting. Known-line energies may move by 5 eV and widths satisfy 0<ΔE/E<10⁻². Nearby K/Ar lines are bounded using reference S/Ca fluxes and AtomDB; Ar XVII DR initially receives 0.001–0.01 of the 3.12 keV triplet flux.

evidence.text: Reduce observations with SAS 13.0.0, apply espfilt, and assess residual soft-proton contamination through an in-FoV/out-FoV count-rate diagnostic. Stack central and off-center M31 spectra separately and bin them at 60 eV.

sources.title: Checking the Dark Matter Origin of a 3.53 keV Line with the Milky Way Center

evidence.text: Reduce archival MOS pointings with Sgr A* within 0.5 arcminutes of the telescope axis using SAS and soft-proton flare screening. Exclude the MJD 54000–54500 flaring period, combine 14-arcminute spectra with addspec, and subtract rescaled closed-filter backgrounds normalized using energies above 10 keV.
